verdict.rationale: Dagster provides asset checks to validate schema and null constraints on tabular assets, and integrates with dbt/Fivetran/Airbyte/dlt which perform the actual typing/deduplication of loaded data, but Dagster itself is an orchestrator, not the engine producing typed/deduplicated destination tables. Missing for 10: direct evidence of Dagster performing deduplication logic, native typed-table materialization, and hands-on confirmation that end-to-end loaded tables are clean and query-ready rather than requiring the coupled dbt/Fivetran/dlt tooling to do the real work.
